newsitem.title: USA: CBOT SOYBEANS SHARPLY HIGHER WITH CORN FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: CBOT SOYBEANS SHARPLY HIGHER WITH CORN FUTURES.

text.p: Limit gains in CBOT corn futures pushed soybeans to sharp gains early Tuesday despite forecasts for a record soybean crop from USDA, traders said.
"Corn is dragging the beans up," said one floor trader.
USDA forecast the 1997/98 (Sept/Aug) soybean crop at 2.744 billion bushels. That figure is 15 percent higher than last year's output and above trade expectations for 2.607 billion to 2.731 billion.
Calls had initially been lower, but the limit gains in CBOT corn caused a surge of buying in soybeans early, traders said.
